name: ETH3D: High-Resolution Multi-View Stereo Benchmark
description: ETH3D High-Resolution Multi-View Stereo Benchmark is a benchmark for high-resolution 3D multi-view reconstruction and stereo matching. Captured using calibrated high-resolution (24 megapixel) DSLR cameras and millimeter-accurate laser scanner ground truth across 25 indoor and outdoor scenes (13 training, 12 test), it provides rigorous geometric ground truth for evaluating point cloud reconstruction, depth map fusion, and multi-view stereo under complex geometry and varying real-world illumination.
